arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type AS card_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions grouped by the card type of the card used, most common first.
assumptions: Counts every transaction, whether or not it has a fraud label.
Card type is taken from the card used on each transaction (cards.card_type), with 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)' shown as separate types.
Transactions whose card_id has no matching card are excluded by the inner join.
